textRuns.value: Organizations often rely on CVSS severity scores to prioritize vulnerabilities, but severity alone does not show whether a vulnerability is being actively exploited or how likely exploitation may be. This can make it difficult for security and GRC teams to determine which issues require immediate attention.

I built this portfolio project to explore a more risk-based approach to vulnerability prioritization. Using public data from CISA KEV, NIST NVD and FIRST EPSS, I combined evidence of active exploitation, technical severity and exploitation probability in a two-page Power BI dashboard. The project demonstrates how public vulnerability intelligence can be transformed into clear insights that support risk discussions, triage decisions and resource prioritization.
This dashboard was created as a portfolio analysis and was not deployed within an organization or connected to a company’s internal security environment.
